name: Programming Languages and Frameworks
blurb: The languages AI is written in and the frameworks built on top of them, tracked by adoption, releases, licence, and integrations.

reading.body:
This hub currently contains no tracked data points, only three subcategories covering programming languages, AI frameworks, and inference engines.

The structure separates the languages AI is written in from the frameworks built on top of them and the engines that serve models. Python, Rust, C++, Mojo, and Julia sit in the first group. LangChain, LlamaIndex, DSPy, and Semantic Kernel sit in the second. vLLM, TensorRT, and llama.cpp sit in the third.

The intended tracking covers adoption, releases, licence, and integrations, but no such measurements appear in the data. The total is zero and the points list is empty. Because no adoption, release, licence, or integration figures are present, the data supports no conclusion about compute, buildings, or power.
